title: Sporting vs Man United 2–2: Pens, a Red & Still No Win 😩 #MUFC #shorts
description:
Sporting CP and Manchester United drew 2–2 in the Champions League in Lisbon. Luis Suárez scored a penalty and a late equaliser for Sporting; Bruno Fernandes scored a penalty and a second goal against his old club. Goalkeeper Senne Lammens' error led to Sporting's equaliser and Youri Tielemans was sent off in stoppage time, so Mauricio Pochettino is still waiting for his first win as United manager.

title: Every European Cup Three-Peat Ever 🏆 Can PSG Make It 3? #UCL #shorts
description:
Only three clubs have won the European Cup or Champions League three seasons in a row: Real Madrid (five straight from 1956 to 1960, and three from 2016 to 2018), Ajax (1971–1973) and Bayern Munich (1974–1976). Paris Saint-Germain won the Champions League in 2025 (5–0 v Inter) and 2026 (1–1 v Arsenal, won on penalties) and are trying to become the first three-in-a-row winners since Real Madrid.

Champions League table and scores: https://scorebuzz.net

title: LeBron James Triple-Double vs Giannis | 76ers vs Heat 111–104 🔥 #shorts
description:
